nasa_gistemp.name: NASA GISTEMP v4 (Observed)
nasa_gistemp.description: Global Surface Temperature Anomalies (Land-Ocean Temperature Index, LOTI) derived from NOAA GHCN v4 (meteorological stations) and ERSST v5 (ocean areas).
nasa_gistemp.source_name: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies (GISS)
nasa_gistemp.citation: GISTEMP Team, 2025: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP), version 4. NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies. Lenssen et al., 2019, JGR Atmospheres.
limitations: Pre-1900 observations have sparse spatial coverage across the Southern Hemisphere and oceans.
Anomalies express deviation from the 1951-1980 climatological baseline, not absolute temperature.
Urban Heat Island (UHI) adjustments are applied, but minor local microclimate biases may persist.
Annual values reflect natural variability (e.g., El Niño-Southern Oscillation, volcanic eruptions) superimposed on long-term trends.

synthetic_demo.name: Synthetic Scenario (Demonstration)
synthetic_demo.description: Artificially generated climate anomaly time-series designed for educational demonstrations, testing, and offline algorithm validation.
synthetic_demo.citation: Simulated scenario generated using deterministic sinusoidal cycles (ENSO proxy) + 0.18°C/decade linear trend + Gaussian noise.
limitations: SYNTHETIC DATA: Not based on real physical measurements.
Values should NEVER be used for scientific attribution or policy making.
Intended exclusively for platform feature demonstration and edge-case testing.
